notes: Shopping + planner improvements. New: when you add something to the shopping list, Stashpot now warns if you already have it in the pantry (and flags similar items -- type 'chicken' and it shows chicken breast + chicken broth), so you don't double-buy. New items now default to the 'Other' location instead of Pantry. Fixed: shopping items with a slash in the name (e.g. 'sourdough/Italian bread') wouldn't save. Planner: the Month/2-weeks/Week control is now a dropdown showing the current view, plus a little breathing room under the calendar.
